lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup.{u_1} E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace.{0, u_1} ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace.{u_1} E]
  {f : E → ℝ} {X : ℝ → E} {z : E} {T : ℝ},
  LT.lt.{0} 0 T →
    ContDiff.{0, u_1, 0} ℝ 1 f →
      IsMinOn.{u_1, 0} f Set.univ.{u_1} z →
        ContinuousOn.{0, u_1} X (Set.Icc.{0} 0 T) →
          (∀ (t : ℝ),
              Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Set.Ico.{0} 0 T) t →
                HasDerivWithinAt.{0, u_1} X (Neg.neg.{u_1} (gradient.{0, u_1} f (X t))) (Set.Ici.{0} t) t) →
            ∃ s,
              Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Set.Icc.{0} 0 T) s ∧
                IsMinOn.{0, 0} (fun u => norm.{u_1} (gradient.{0, u_1} f (X u))) (Set.Icc.{0} 0 T) s ∧
                  LE.le.{0} (norm.{u_1} (gradient.{0, u_1} f (X s)))
                    √(HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (f (X 0)) (f z)) T)
approved_definition_context: ContDiff R 1 f means continuously Frechet differentiable. gradient f x is the Riesz representative of its Frechet derivative in the complete real inner-product space.

Set.Icc a b is [a,b]; Set.Ico a b is [a,b); Set.Ici t is [t,infinity). HasDerivWithinAt X v (Set.Ici t) t is the right derivative equal to v. ContinuousOn means relative continuity including both endpoints of a closed interval.

IsMinOn g S s means g(s)<=g(u) for every u in S; membership of s in S must be separately supplied. Set.univ is the entire space. Real.sqrt is the nonnegative real square root (zero for negative input).
